name: Chemical Engineering
notes: Requires a GPA of at least 2.0. The minor is a coherent sequence of 16 credits, modeled as four 4-credit CHE courses.
CHEM 131 and MATH 161 are prerequisites, not part of the 16 credits.
CHE 391 Independent Study requires instructor and department permission.
The department also offers a separate Environmental Engineering minor, not yet encoded.
